lines.port: /* The EXP SHARE option (3ds_poketouch_options.c): 0 the game's own, 1 every Pokemon that can still fight shares as if it held
* an EXP. SHARE, 2 every one of them gets the full amount a Pokemon that fought gets. */
holdEffect = HOLD_EFFECT_NONE;      // the full share goes to everyone: no half for the holders
gBattleStruct->sentInPokes |= 1;    // every one counts as having fought: the full share each
if (ItemId_GetHoldEffect(item) == HOLD_EFFECT_LUCKY_EGG)    // the item, not holdEffect: the EXP SHARE option changes that
